dispositions.title: Gates check mechanics only, must fail on purpose before they are trusted, and never encode hedging; exit codes are read unpiped; a grep never concludes; check the object, not its shadow.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Questions to him: only real decisions, each standalone in plain words, with the current and proposed text verbatim, the options and consequences and a recommendation; no internal codes; never one the record settles.
dispositions.reason: Questions/approval formatting does not create a new permission step; proceed under the current principal authorization.

dispositions.title: Act on his rulings: answers apply globally; no follow-up question about scope; never ask him to prove a fact.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: The newest, strongest build replaces the old; never ask him to choose between versions.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Sweep every instance, sibling and generator in one pass; never generalise a narrow ruling beyond the scope he gave it.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Before calling a set final, check the brief against the ledger and unmerged branches. One session's implementation is not his approval.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Read the raw transcripts, the live thread and our own sent outbound before drafting; never build from processed notes, digests or compacted summaries.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Fix the artifact itself, at its source. A report, plan, gate or review is never the deliverable; after a cut, re-read what pointed at it.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Keep every version with a restore path; build both versions when he asks for alternatives or an adviser and he differ.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: No model, LLM or harness name in any persistent artifact.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Writer seats: any lane may start Astra max writers without asking; they run headless from a brief file; parallel as the work needs; outputs are composed, not concatenated.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Every directive goes into the ledger verbatim with its source and is applied uniformly; recorded is not delivered; every prompt has a recorded disposition.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Finish the work end to end inside the authorised scope; recommending is not doing; never stop to report what was not done.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Build the strongest possible form: what a top professional would do, from the rawest material, never downgrading a claim and never offering him a menu of framings.
dispositions.reason: Strongest-form aspiration does not permit promotion of unproved mathematics; quality and source checks are captured by EGA-06 and EGA-31.

dispositions.title: Every sentence-level sweep triggers a re-composition and image review of every page it touched.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Every sendable output goes to `~/tosend/out/<Recipient>/` with its message as plain text, a 00 brief and SHA256SUMS; one enclosing folder per set holds the latest of everything; open it for him.
dispositions.reason: Commercial destination and covering-message package, not this audit output destination.

dispositions.title: He alone sends. No agent sends, uploads or publishes; reports say "ready for you to send"; a staging folder is not dispatch evidence; drafting is not execution.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: A rebuild under the constraint set keeps the earlier set as a version in the same folder: v1-before-constraint-set/ holds the old files unchanged, v2-constraint-set/ holds the new ones, and a top-level 00 brief names both and says which to send.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Recipients are his: no draft or brief recommends or asks who is copied or forwarded to.
dispositions.reason: Commercial copy/forward routing; no message to others is authorized here.

dispositions.title: A hold or supersession is written at the top of the folder's brief within the hour, with the UTC time and the folder to use instead.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Every replaced file is archived under `~/tosend/archive/<date>-<Folder>-before-<change>/`; a sent folder is an immutable record.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: PDFs: nothing attached inside; papers under 1 MB; render exit codes read unpiped and `file -b` checked; the send gate passes before placement.
dispositions.reason: Specific PDF placement gate and paper file-size target; relevant output checks are EGA-38, EGA-51 and EGA-53, not inherited delivery limits.

dispositions.title: Ship form: designed deliverables as PDF rendered from HTML; letters and instruments as .docx through `scripts/generate-legal-docx.py`; spreadsheets through Java/LibreOffice, neatly organised with metadata.
dispositions.reason: Business artifact production formats; this task has its own website and mathematical source conventions.

dispositions.title: A follow-up set takes the Kenneth Gay structure: a main document, companion notes that each answer one ask, the message and the private brief.
dispositions.reason: Named commercial follow-up folder structure; no EGA structural authority.

dispositions.title: File and folder hygiene: gapless numbering from 00; unique names; no Markdown to readers; no reliance on an INDEX; no empty or singly nested folders; no duplicates or stale copies.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Executed and received instruments are preserved byte for byte; external materials are corrected in place, never withdrawn; covering material carries the ruled form.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Rooms: publication only through the release pipeline and `./ship`, on his word; every room edit tested against the whole ledger; every room carries every instrument; outward cuts by allowlist; the internal room never ships to a commercial counterparty.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: Websites: change the copy, not the design; both sites; publication only on his word; every public card checked against his own words.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: When he asks for files to be placed or opened, do it at once, without process narration.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: One live draft per person: a new set for someone retires every older draft to that person in the same pass, and the indexes he reads name the live set.
dispositions.reason: Apply only the normalized requirement and its explicit exception; retain the original text and scope as evidence.

dispositions.title: A package for a team member or partner is complete: role brief, Start Here, Team, participation offer and cover note.
dispositions.reason: Team-member package contents are out of scope.

dispositions.title: A stored signature goes only on the document his current chat names, with capacity and date; otherwise signature blocks stay blank.
dispositions.reason: Signature authorization is unrelated; no instrument is signed here.
